_method: Per item: grep of live-maths-all.txt (3,140 live maths rows, all families, dumped 2026-10-08) and alg-held-and-prior.json (77 held/recent Algebra items) for the item's mechanism keywords; every hit read by hand. Verdict dup = same chain of steps on the same kind of givens to the same asked quantity.

SM26F-A08.verdict: clear on dup; RETURN on plug-back (b = 23 smallest checks in one step) || return: no solution + stated solution | m + n -> 0 linear hits; one-variable no-solution k rows exist, A08 continues to a second parameter and the sum (different asked quantity); replacement clear

SM26F-A12.verdict: RETURN: mechanism duplicate of live 86e82bde / 9152eace || return: number line distance | markers -> 71b9faca (distance between two given points) different; replacement clear

Clear.

SM26F-C08.verdict: RETURNED (dup 41ab8b0a). Replacement (elimination multiplier m making the y-terms cancel; key 7/5): grep multiplies each side | terms cancel | eliminate -> 0 hits. Clear.

_recheck_v26alg: 2026-10-08, after sat-math-v26-alg inserted 25 Algebra rows mid-authoring: dumps re-pulled (3,165 live maths) and every B and C item read against the 25 by hand. B: none share a chain (the new rows are parameter-range / integer-count inequalities). C01 vs 383c8b40 (no-solution k, then the constant price gap): C01 continues to the y-intercept of the second line, a different follow-on; clear. C: no other overlap. A02 vs e26c893e (f(x) = k(x - 2) + 5 solvable for every k -> c): same chain (the k-factor root fixes a point that determines c); A02 added to the A return round (still open). D authoring and the A/C returns told to grep the refreshed dumps.
